name: capture.code
description: A new link code for the caller on the capture account: the Ideas page shows it, and the person DMs LINK and the code to the account. Keeps only its keyed hash (HMAC-SHA256, made in packages/connect), single use, for ten minutes; an earlier code of the caller goes. A person only. Internal: packages/connect makes the code.
sql: with gone as (delete from brandbase.capture_codes k where k.user_id = brandbase.caller() and k.account = :account), made as (insert into brandbase.capture_codes (account, code_hash, user_id, name, expires_at) select :account, :codeHash, u.id, coalesce(nullif(u.name, ''), split_part(u.email, '@', 1)), :now::timestamptz + interval '10 minutes' from brandbase.users u where u.id = brandbase.caller() returning expires_at) select jsonb_build_object('expiresAt', brandbase.iso(made.expires_at)) as result from made
